t: The Antinox X-Board Surface Protector provides robust temporary floor and surface protection for various trade jobs. Ideal for construction sites, painting projects, plastering work, or general renovation tasks, it safeguards floors from damage and spills. This heavy-duty surface protector, measuring 90cm x 30m and covering 27m², features specialist Spill Block technology, ensuring paint, mud, and water will not penetrate to the surfaces below. It rolls out flat for easy application and is completely water-resistant, reusable, and long lasting, offering efficiency on site. Its breathable design makes it suitable for use on floors that need to cure.
